{{Top|leg}}
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[High General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] served as the head of '''Army Operations''' aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. In addition, the position of [[Army Operations Chief]], the position of second in command, was held by [[Trech Molock/Legends|Trech Molock]] at this time, which resulted in bickering.
